# Supported basics

Regular text with *emphasis*, **strong emphasis**, ~~strikethrough~~, and
`inline code`.

## Lists

1. First ordered item
2. Second ordered item

- Unordered item
- Another item
  - Nested item

## Task list

- [x] A finished task
- [ ] An unfinished task

## Table

| Feature | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| Tables  | yes       |
| HTML    | no        |

## Code

```cpp
int main() { return 0; }
```
